artworks.title: Odysseus and Nausicaa
artworks.description: Lastman's Munich canvas freezes Odyssey 6 at the river mouth: the shipwrecked Odysseus kneels before Nausicaa while her startled handmaids scatter. The Phaeacian princess stands as the civilised welcome that will send the wanderer home.

artworks.title: Coastal Landscape with Ulysses and Nausicaa
artworks.description: Rubens sets the meeting on a windy Phaeacian shore — Odysseus emerging from the brush, Nausicaa and her train with the laundry carts Homer names. The Palazzo Pitti panel turns hospitality into a Baroque coastal drama.

artworks.title: Ulysses and Nausicaa
artworks.description: Desubleo's Bolognese oil gathers Nausicaa and her companions around the half-naked stranger — the Homeric ball game interrupted by awe. The princess's calm gesture steadies the scene as Athena's plan unfolds.

artworks.title: Odysseus and Nausicaa
artworks.description: Preller the Elder's history painting renders the Odyssean threshold: brine-caked Odysseus supplicates the composed Phaeacian princess while her maids flee. Neoclassical balance makes Nausicaa the face of civilised welcome.

films.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
films.description: Miyazaki borrowed the Homeric princess's name for his wind-riding heroine — Nausicaa reborn as ecological saviour in a poisoned future.

films.title: Ulysses
films.description: Rossana Podestà's Nausicaa finds the amnesiac stranger on the Phaeacian shore — laundry, almost-marriage, and the memory that sends him home.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Katie Carr's Nausicaa recovers the shipwrecked king among her handmaidens — the civilised welcome that secretly lands him on Ithaca.

popCulture.title: Homer's Daughter
popCulture.creator: Robert Graves
popCulture.description: Graves invents a Sicilian princess who is Nausicaa — and argues she wrote the Odyssey to save her house from suitors.

popCulture.title: Nausicaa
popCulture.description: Nausicaa remains the type of the generous princess at the water's edge — the Odyssey's most graceful host, forever almost a bride.

music.title: Nausicaa
music.description: Glanville-Hicks sets Graves' Homer's Daughter at the Odeon of Herodes Atticus — Nausicaa as author-heroine rewriting the Odyssey in her own voice.
